title.sk: Spanakopita – grécky koláč so špenátom a fetou
title.en: Spanakopita: Greek spinach and feta pie

description.sk: Chrumkavé lístkové cesto plnené špenátom, fetou, jarnou cibuľkou a kôprom.
description.en: Crisp puff pastry filled with spinach, feta, spring onions and dill.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 190 °C. Čerstvý špenát umy a v širokom hrnci ho za stáleho miešania nechaj 3 minúty zvädnúť; mrazený len rozmraz. Nechaj ho vychladnúť v sitku a potom ho rukami vytlač takmer dosucha – voda by spodok koláča rozmočila.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Wash fresh spinach and wilt it in a wide pan for 3 minutes, stirring; simply thaw frozen spinach. Cool it in a sieve, then squeeze it almost dry with your hands, as any water would make the base soggy.

steps.sk: Jarnú cibuľku nakrájaj nadrobno a speň ju na oleji 3 minúty. Špenát nasekaj a zmiešaj s cibuľkou, rozdrobenou fetou, 2 vajcami, kôprom, muškátovým orieškom, štipkou soli a korením.
steps.en: Finely slice the spring onions and soften them in the oil for 3 minutes. Chop the spinach and mix it with the onions, crumbled feta, 2 eggs, dill, nutmeg, a pinch of salt and the pepper.

steps.sk: Plech alebo formu s rozmermi asi 30 × 20 cm vylož polovicou lístkového cesta tak, aby prečnievalo cez okraje. Rozotri naň plnku a prikry ju druhou polovicou cesta. Okraje zahni dovnútra a pevne ich pritlač.
steps.en: Line a tin of about 30 × 20 cm with half the puff pastry so it overhangs the edges. Spread the filling over it and cover with the second half of the pastry. Fold the edges inwards and press them firmly together.

steps.sk: Vrch potri rozšľahaným vajcom, posyp sezamom a ostrým nožom ho narež na 8 dielov až po plnku. Para tak unikne a upečený koláč sa ľahšie krája.
steps.en: Brush the top with the beaten egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and score it into 8 portions with a sharp knife, down to the filling. This lets the steam out and makes the baked pie easier to cut.

steps.sk: Peč 35 až 40 minút, kým nie je cesto vysoko nadýchané a sýto zlatohnedé aj na spodku. Nechaj ho 10 minút vychladnúť, aby sa plnka usadila.
steps.en: Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until the pastry is well risen and deep golden, underneath too. Let it cool for 10 minutes so the filling settles.

steps.sk: Podávaj teplý alebo vlažný s jogurtom a šalátom z paradajok a uhoriek. Vydrží 3 dni v chladničke; prehrej ho v rúre, aby cesto znova chrumkalo.
steps.en: Serve warm or lukewarm with yogurt and a tomato and cucumber salad. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days; reheat it in the oven so the pastry crisps up again.

title.sk: Gigantes plaki – zapekaná fazuľa v paradajkách s kôprom
title.en: Gigantes plaki: Greek baked beans in tomato and dill

description.sk: Biela fazuľa zapečená v hustej paradajkovej omáčke s olivovým olejom, kôprom a oreganom.
description.en: White beans baked in a thick tomato sauce with olive oil, dill and oregano.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 190 °C. Cibuľu nakrájaj na polkolieska, mrkvu a zeler na drobné kocky a cesnak nadrobno. Fazuľu sceď a prepláchni.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Slice the onions into half-moons, dice the carrot and celery small and chop the garlic finely. Drain and rinse the beans.

steps.sk: V panvici vhodnej do rúry rozohrej 3 lyžice oleja a zeleninu na ňom opekaj na miernom ohni 10 minút, kým nezmäkne. Pridaj cesnak a pretlak a miešaj minútu.
steps.en: Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in an ovenproof pan and cook the vegetables gently for 10 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and tomato paste and stir for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky, 200 ml vody, oregano, cukor, soľ a korenie a var 10 minút. Vmiešaj fazuľu, kôpor a petržlenovú vňať a povrch pokvapkaj zvyšným olejom.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, 200 ml water, the oregano, sugar, salt and pepper and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in the beans, dill and parsley and drizzle the remaining oil over the top.

steps.sk: Peč odkryté 30 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne a fazuľa navrchu nie je mierne opečená. Ak vysychá, prilej trochu vody.
steps.en: Bake uncovered for 30 minutes until the sauce is thick and the beans on top are lightly browned. Add a little water if it dries out.

steps.sk: Podávaj teplé alebo vlažné s chlebom. V Grécku sa toto jedlo je často izbovej teploty; v chladničke vydrží 4 dni.
steps.en: Serve warm or lukewarm with bread. In Greece it is often eaten at room temperature; it keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

title.sk: Briam – grécka pečená zelenina s olivovým olejom
title.en: Briam: Greek roasted vegetables in olive oil

description.sk: Zemiaky, cuketa, baklažán a paprika pomaly pečené v paradajkách s cesnakom a oreganom.
description.en: Potatoes, courgette, aubergine and peppers slowly roasted in tomatoes with garlic and oregano.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kolieska hrubé 5 mm, cuketu a baklažán na kolieska hrubé 1 cm, papriky na prúžky a cibuľu na mesiačiky.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Peel the potatoes and slice them 5 mm thick; slice the courgettes and aubergine 1 cm thick, the peppers into strips and the onions into wedges.

steps.sk: Paradajky nastrúhaj na hrubom strúhadle, šupka ti zostane v ruke. Zmiešaj ich s prelisovaným cesnakom, olejom, oreganom, soľou, korením a 100 ml vody.
steps.en: Grate the tomatoes on a coarse grater; the skins stay in your hand. Mix the pulp with the crushed garlic, oil, oregano, salt, pepper and 100 ml water.

steps.sk: Všetku zeleninu premiešaj v pekáči s paradajkovou zmesou a uhlaď. Zemiaky nech sú prevažne dole pod ostatnou zeleninou – potrebujú najviac šťavy a času.
steps.en: Toss all the vegetables with the tomato mixture in a roasting dish and level them out. Keep the potatoes mostly underneath, as they need the most liquid and time.

steps.sk: Prikry alobalom a peč 30 minút, potom odkry, premiešaj a peč ďalších 30 až 40 minút, kým zelenina nie je mäkká, šťava hustá a okraje opečené.
steps.en: Cover with foil and roast for 30 minutes, then uncover, stir and roast for another 30 to 40 minutes until the vegetables are tender, the juices thick and the edges browned.

steps.sk: Posyp petržlenovou vňaťou a nechaj 10 minút odpočinúť. Podávaj s chlebom. Briam chutí aj studený, preto je ideálny na prípravu dopredu – vydrží 4 dni.
steps.en: Scatter with parsley and let it rest for 10 minutes. Serve with bread. Briam is good cold too, which makes it ideal for cooking ahead; it keeps for 4 days.

title.en: Kotopoulo lemonato: Greek lemon chicken with potatoes

description.sk: Kuracie stehná a zemiaky pečené v jednom pekáči s citrónom, cesnakom a oreganom.
description.en: Chicken thighs and potatoes roasted in one dish with lemon, garlic and oregano.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj pozdĺžne na mesiačiky hrubé 2 cm. Citróny umy horúcou vodou, z jedného nastrúhaj kôru a z oboch vytlač šťavu.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Peel the potatoes and cut them lengthways into 2 cm wedges. Scrub the lemons in hot water, finely grate the zest of one and squeeze the juice of both.

steps.sk: V mise zmiešaj citrónovú šťavu a kôru, olej, prelisovaný cesnak, oregano, horčicu, soľ a korenie. Polovicou marinády natri stehná, zvyškom premiešaj zemiaky.
steps.en: In a bowl, mix the lemon juice and zest, oil, crushed garlic, oregano, mustard, salt and pepper. Rub half the marinade over the thighs and toss the potatoes in the rest.

steps.sk: Zemiaky rozlož do pekáča, mäso polož medzi ne a podlej 300 ml horúcej vody s rozpusteným bujónom. Zemiaky ho postupne vsaknú, budú mäkké a citrónové.
steps.en: Spread the potatoes in a roasting dish, nestle the chicken among them and pour in 300 ml hot water with the stock cube dissolved in it. The potatoes soak it up and turn soft and lemony.

steps.sk: Peč odkryté 50 až 60 minút, v polovici zemiaky obráť a mäso polej šťavou; ak šťava úplne vyschne, prilej trochu vody. Mäso je hotové pri 74 °C a zemiaky sú mäkké a na okrajoch chrumkavé.
steps.en: Roast uncovered for 50 to 60 minutes, turning the potatoes and basting the chicken halfway; add a little water if the juices dry up completely. The chicken is done at 74 °C, with the potatoes soft and crisp at the edges.

steps.sk: Podávaj s gréckym šalátom alebo tzatziki. V krabičkách vydrží 3 dni a výborne sa prehrieva v rúre.
steps.en: Serve with a Greek salad or tzatziki. It keeps in boxes for 3 days and reheats very well in the oven.

title.sk: Bravčový gyros v pite s tzatziki

description.sk: Marinované prúžky bravčového opečené dochrumkava, v teplej pite s tzatziki, paradajkou a cibuľou.
description.en: Marinated pork strips seared until crisp, in warm pitta with tzatziki, tomato and onion.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na tenké prúžky hrubé 5 mm. Zmiešaj ho s 2 lyžicami oleja, citrónovou šťavou, 2 prelisovanými strúčikmi cesnaku, oreganom, paprikou, rímskym kmínom, ¾ lyžičky soli a korením a nechaj 30 minút marinovať.
steps.en: Cut the pork into thin strips 5 mm thick. Mix it with 2 tablespoons of oil, the lemon juice, 2 crushed garlic cloves, the oregano, paprika, cumin, ¾ teaspoon of salt and the pepper and leave to marinate for 30 minutes.

steps.sk: Na tzatziki uhorku nastrúhaj, posoľ štipkou soli a po 5 minútach ju vytlač. Zmiešaj ju s jogurtom, zvyšným cesnakom a lyžicou oleja. Paradajky nakrájaj na mesiačiky a cibuľu na tenké plátky.
steps.en: For the tzatziki, grate the cucumber, salt it with a pinch of salt and squeeze it out after 5 minutes. Mix it with the yogurt, remaining garlic and a tablespoon of oil. Cut the tomatoes into wedges and slice the onion thinly.

steps.sk: Veľkú panvicu rozpáľ na silnom ohni a mäso opekaj v dvoch dávkach 6 až 8 minút, kým nie je dohneda opečené a na okrajoch chrumkavé. Panvicu nepreplňuj, mäso by sa dusilo vo vlastnej šťave. Bravčové je hotové pri 70 °C.
steps.en: Get a large frying pan very hot and fry the pork in two batches for 6 to 8 minutes until browned and crisp at the edges. Do not crowd the pan or the meat stews in its own juices. The pork is done at 70 °C.

steps.sk: Pity zohrej na suchej panvici 30 sekúnd z každej strany, kým nezmäknú a nenafúknu sa.
steps.en: Warm the pittas in a dry frying pan for 30 seconds on each side until soft and puffed.

steps.sk: Na každú pitu natri lyžicu tzatziki, pridaj mäso, paradajky a cibuľu, zroluj ju a spodok zabaľ do papiera. Podávaj hneď; opečené mäso vydrží v chladničke 3 dni a na panvici sa rýchlo prehreje.
steps.en: Spread each pitta with a spoonful of tzatziki, add the pork, tomatoes and onion, roll it up and wrap the base in paper. Serve straight away; the cooked pork keeps in the fridge for 3 days and reheats quickly in a pan.

title.sk: Krevety saganaki s paradajkami a fetou
title.en: Shrimp saganaki with tomatoes and feta

description.sk: Krevety dusené v paradajkovej omáčke s vínom, cesnakom a oreganom, so zmäknutou fetou.
description.en: Prawns simmered in a tomato sauce with wine, garlic and oregano under softened feta.

steps.sk: Mrazené krevety rozmraz v chladničke alebo pod studenou vodou a osuš ich papierovou utierkou. Jarnú cibuľku nakrájaj na kolieska a cesnak na tenké plátky.
steps.en: Thaw frozen prawns in the fridge or under cold running water and pat them dry with kitchen paper. Slice the spring onions into rounds and the garlic thinly.

steps.sk: V panvici rozohrej olej a cibuľku s cesnakom na ňom opekaj 2 minúty. Prilej víno a nechaj ho 1 minútu povrieť, potom pridaj paradajky, oregano a čili a var 10 minút do hustej omáčky.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the spring onions and garlic for 2 minutes. Pour in the wine and let it bubble for 1 minute, then add the tomatoes, oregano and chilli and simmer for 10 minutes into a thick sauce.

steps.sk: Krevety vlož do omáčky, aby boli ponorené, a navrch rozdrob fetu. Panvicu prikry a var na miernom ohni 4 až 5 minút, kým krevety nezružovejú a nestočia sa do tvaru C. Krevety stočené do tvaru O sú prevarené a gumové.
steps.en: Push the prawns into the sauce so they are submerged and crumble the feta over the top. Cover and simmer gently for 4 to 5 minutes until the prawns turn pink and curl into a C shape. Prawns curled into an O are overcooked and rubbery.

steps.sk: Posyp petržlenovou vňaťou a ochutnaj – feta je slaná, preto dosoľ štipkou soli až na konci, ak treba.
steps.en: Scatter with parsley and taste; feta is salty, so add the pinch of salt only at the end, if needed.

steps.sk: Podávaj priamo v panvici s chlebom na vytieranie omáčky alebo s ryžou. Krevety zjedz hneď, pri ohrievaní tvrdnú.
steps.en: Serve in the pan with bread to mop up the sauce, or with rice. Eat the prawns straight away, as they toughen when reheated.

title.sk: Kofta kebab s cesnakovým jogurtom a bulgurom
title.en: Beef kofta kebabs with garlic yogurt and bulgur

description.sk: Korenisté šúľky z mletého hovädzieho s petržlenovou vňaťou, chladivý jogurt s mätou a bulgur.
description.en: Spiced minced beef kebabs with parsley, cool mint yogurt and bulgur.

steps.sk: Bulgur zalej 400 ml vriacej vody so štipkou soli, prikry a nechaj 15 minút napučať. Cibuľu nastrúhaj najemno a vytlač z nej šťavu, aby kebab nebol vodnatý.
steps.en: Pour 400 ml boiling water with a pinch of salt over the bulgur, cover and leave for 15 minutes to swell. Finely grate the onion and squeeze out its juice so the kebabs are not watery.

steps.sk: Mäso zmiešaj s cibuľou, 2 prelisovanými strúčikmi cesnaku, petržlenovou vňaťou, rímskym kmínom, koriandrom, paprikou, škoricou, soľou a korením. Miešaj ho rukou 2 minúty, kým nie je lepkavé – potom bude držať tvar.
steps.en: Mix the beef with the onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves, the parsley, cumin, coriander, paprika, cinnamon, salt and pepper. Work it with your hand for 2 minutes until sticky, so it holds its shape.

steps.sk: Mokrými rukami z neho vytvaruj 12 podlhovastých šúľkov dlhých 10 cm a, ak máš, napichni ich na špajle. Daj ich na 10 minút do chladničky, aby sa spevnili.
steps.en: With wet hands, shape 12 sausages about 10 cm long and thread them onto skewers if you have them. Chill them for 10 minutes to firm up.

steps.sk: Grilovaciu alebo obyčajnú panvicu potri olejom a rozpáľ na stredne silnom ohni. Kebaby opekaj 8 až 10 minút a každé 2 minúty ich pootoč, kým nie sú zo všetkých strán opečené a vnútri nemajú 71 °C.
steps.en: Brush a griddle or frying pan with oil and heat it over a medium-high heat. Cook the kebabs for 8 to 10 minutes, turning every 2 minutes, until browned all over and 71 °C inside.

steps.sk: Jogurt zmiešaj so zvyšným cesnakom, nasekanou mätou a štipkou soli. Paradajky a uhorku nakrájaj na kocky. Podávaj kebaby na bulgure so zeleninou a jogurtom; v krabičkách vydržia 3 dni.
steps.en: Mix the yogurt with the remaining garlic, chopped mint and a pinch of salt. Dice the tomatoes and cucumber. Serve the kebabs on the bulgur with the vegetables and yogurt; they keep in boxes for 3 days.

title.sk: Lahmacun – turecká tenká placka s mletým mäsom
title.en: Lahmacun: Turkish flatbread with spiced minced beef

description.sk: Tenučké chrumkavé placky potreté korenistým mäsom, zrolované s petržlenovou vňaťou, cibuľou a citrónom.
description.en: Wafer-thin crisp flatbreads spread with spiced meat, rolled up with parsley, onion and lemon.

steps.sk: Droždie s cukrom rozmiešaj v 180 ml vlažnej vody. Pridaj múku, ¾ lyžičky soli a olej a vymies hladké, mäkké cesto. Prikry ho a nechaj 45 minút kysnúť na teplom mieste.
steps.en: Stir the yeast and sugar into 180 ml lukewarm water. Add the flour, ¾ teaspoon of salt and the oil and knead into a smooth, soft dough. Cover and leave it to rise somewhere warm for 45 minutes.

steps.sk: Cibuľu, papriku a paradajku nakrájaj nadrobno alebo ich krátko rozmixuj, nie však na kašu. Zmiešaj ich s mäsom, pretlakom, prelisovaným cesnakom, polovicou petržlenovej vňate, paprikou, čili, rímskym kmínom a zvyšnou soľou na jemnú pastu.
steps.en: Chop the onion, pepper and tomato very finely, or pulse them briefly without turning them to mush. Mix them with the beef, tomato paste, crushed garlic, half the parsley, the paprika, chilli, cumin and remaining salt into a fine paste.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na najvyššiu teplotu (250 °C) aj s plechom vnútri. Cesto rozdeľ na 8 guliek a každú rozvaľkaj na tenký ovál s dĺžkou 25 cm. Mäsovú zmes rozotri až po okraje tak tenko, aby cez ňu miestami presvitalo cesto.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to its highest setting (250 °C) with a baking tray inside. Divide the dough into 8 balls and roll each into a thin 25 cm oval. Spread the meat mixture right to the edges, so thinly that the dough shows through in places.

steps.sk: Placky peč po dvoch na rozpálenom plechu s papierom 7 až 9 minút, kým okraje nie sú chrumkavé a mäso upečené – musí byť hnedé, bez ružových miest.
steps.en: Bake the flatbreads two at a time on the hot tray lined with paper for 7 to 9 minutes until the edges are crisp and the meat is cooked: brown, with no pink patches.

steps.sk: Červenú cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké plátky a zmiešaj so zvyšnou petržlenovou vňaťou. Na horúci lahmacun daj cibuľu s vňaťou, pokvapkaj ho citrónom, zroluj a jedz rukami. Upečené placky prehreješ na suchej panvici.
steps.en: Thinly slice the red onion and toss it with the remaining parsley. Top each hot lahmacun with the onion and parsley, squeeze over some lemon, roll it up and eat it with your hands. Reheat baked flatbreads in a dry frying pan.

title.sk: Fattoush s cícerom a chrumkavou pitou
title.en: Fattoush with chickpeas and crispy pitta

description.sk: Libanonský šalát z čerstvej zeleniny, byliniek a opečenej pity s citrónovým dresingom.
description.en: A Lebanese salad of fresh vegetables, herbs and toasted pitta with a lemon dressing.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Pity roztrhni na dve tenké vrstvy a natrhaj na kúsky veľké ako poštová známka. Premiešaj ich s lyžicou oleja a štipkou soli a peč 6 až 8 minút dochrumkava.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Split the pittas into two thin layers and tear them into stamp-sized pieces. Toss them with a tablespoon of oil and a pinch of salt and bake for 6 to 8 minutes until crisp.

steps.sk: Cícer sceď a osuš. Šalát natrhaj, paradajky nakrájaj na kúsky, uhorku na polkolieska, reďkovky na plátky a jarnú cibuľku na kolieska. Bylinky nasekaj nahrubo.
steps.en: Drain and dry the chickpeas. Tear the lettuce, cut the tomatoes into chunks, the cucumber into half-moons, the radishes into slices and the spring onions into rounds. Roughly chop the herbs.

steps.sk: Na dresing rozšľahaj citrónovú šťavu so zvyšným olejom, prelisovaným cesnakom, zvyšnou soľou a korením.
steps.en: For the dressing, whisk the lemon juice with the remaining oil, the crushed garlic, the rest of the salt and the pepper.

steps.sk: Tesne pred podávaním premiešaj zeleninu, cícer a bylinky s dresingom a pridaj chrumkavú pitu. Pita má zostať čiastočne chrumkavá, preto šalát nenechávaj dlho stáť.
steps.en: Just before serving, toss the vegetables, chickpeas and herbs with the dressing and add the crisp pitta. The pitta should stay partly crunchy, so do not let the salad sit.

steps.sk: Podávaj samotný ako ľahký obed alebo k grilovanému mäsu. Zeleninu môžeš nakrájať dopredu; dresing a pitu pridaj až pred jedlom.
steps.en: Serve on its own as a light lunch or alongside grilled meat. You can cut the vegetables ahead; add the dressing and pitta just before eating.

title.sk: Imam bayıldı – plnený baklažán s cibuľou a paradajkami

description.sk: Baklažány plnené sladkou dusenou cibuľou, paradajkami a cesnakom, pečené v olivovom oleji.
description.en: Aubergines stuffed with sweet stewed onions, tomatoes and garlic, baked in olive oil.

steps.sk: Baklažány umy, stopku nechaj a na troch miestach ich pozdĺžne ošúp do pruhov. Uprostred ich pozdĺžne narež do hĺbky, ale nie až na koniec – vznikne vrecko na plnku. Posoľ ich ½ lyžičkou soli a nechaj 20 minút odstáť.
steps.en: Wash the aubergines, leave the stalks on and peel them lengthways in three stripes. Slit each down the middle, deep but not right through, to form a pocket for the filling. Salt them with ½ teaspoon of salt and leave for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska, cesnak na plátky, papriku a paradajky na kocky. Cibuľu opekaj na 2 lyžiciach oleja na miernom ohni 15 minút, kým nie je mäkká a sladká, potom pridaj cesnak, papriku, paradajky, cukor a ¼ lyžičky soli a var 5 minút. Vmiešaj petržlenovú vňať.
steps.en: Slice the onions into thin half-moons and the garlic thinly; dice the pepper and tomatoes. Cook the onions in 2 tablespoons of oil over a low heat for 15 minutes until soft and sweet, then add the garlic, pepper, tomatoes, sugar and ¼ teaspoon of salt and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in the parsley.

steps.sk: Baklažány osuš a opeč ich v panvici na 3 lyžiciach oleja zo všetkých strán 8 minút, kým nezmäknú a nezhnednú. Rúru predhrej na 180 °C.
steps.en: Pat the aubergines dry and fry them in 3 tablespoons of oil for 8 minutes, turning, until softened and browned all over. Preheat the oven to 180 °C.

steps.sk: Baklažány polož do zapekacej misy rezom nahor, opatrne roztvor vrecká a naplň ich cibuľovou zmesou. Pokvapkaj ich zvyšným olejom a citrónovou šťavou a podlej 150 ml vody. Prikry alobalom a peč 30 minút, potom odkry a peč ďalších 10 minút.
steps.en: Lay the aubergines in a baking dish slit side up, gently open the pockets and fill them with the onion mixture. Drizzle with the remaining oil and the lemon juice and pour 150 ml water around them. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes, then uncover and bake for 10 more.

steps.sk: Medzitým zalej bulgur 400 ml vriacej vody so zvyšnou soľou a nechaj ho 15 minút prikrytý napučať.
steps.en: Meanwhile, pour 400 ml boiling water with the remaining salt over the bulgur and leave it covered for 15 minutes to swell.

steps.sk: Imam bayıldı sa podáva vlažný alebo izbovej teploty, keď sa chute spoja. Podávaj ho s bulgurom a, ak chceš, s jogurtom. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni.
steps.en: Imam bayıldı is served warm or at room temperature, once the flavours have settled. Serve with the bulgur and some yogurt if you like. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

title.sk: Maqluba – prevrátená ryža s kuracím a zeleninou
title.en: Maqluba: upside-down rice with chicken and vegetables

description.sk: Palestínske slávnostné jedlo: vrstvy kuracieho, pečenej zeleniny a korenistej ryže vyklopené ako koláč.
description.en: A Palestinian feast dish: layers of chicken, roast vegetables and spiced rice turned out like a cake.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C. Ryžu prepláchni a namoč na 20 minút do studenej vody. Baklažán a zemiaky nakrájaj na plátky hrubé 1 cm, karfiol na ružičky. Zeleninu premiešaj s 2 lyžicami oleja a ½ lyžičky soli a peč na plechu 25 minút do zlatista.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Rinse the rice and soak it in cold water for 20 minutes. Slice the aubergine and potatoes 1 cm thick and break the cauliflower into florets. Toss the vegetables with 2 tablespoons of oil and ½ teaspoon of salt and roast on a tray for 25 minutes until golden.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na veľké kusy a v širokom hrnci ho opeč na lyžici oleja s nakrájanou cibuľou 6 minút. Pridaj cesnak a všetky koreniny, zalej 800 ml vody s bujónom a ¼ lyžičky soli a var 15 minút.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into large pieces and brown it with the chopped onion in a tablespoon of oil in a wide pot for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and all the spices, pour in 800 ml water with the stock cube and ¼ teaspoon of salt and simmer for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Mäso vyber dierovanou lyžicou a vývar odlej do misky, budeš ho potrebovať 750 ml. Dno hrnca vymasti zvyšným olejom a poukladaj naň plátky paradajky, potom mäso a na ne vrstvy pečenej zeleniny.
steps.en: Lift out the chicken with a slotted spoon and pour the stock into a bowl; you will need 750 ml. Grease the bottom of the pot with the remaining oil and lay in the sliced tomatoes, then the chicken, then layers of roast vegetables.

steps.sk: Scedenú ryžu premiešaj so zvyšnou soľou, rovnomerne ju nasyp na zeleninu a jemne pritlač. Opatrne prilej horúci vývar, aby ryžu zakryl o 1 cm. Prikry a var na najmenšom ohni 30 minút, kým ryža nevsiakne všetku tekutinu.
steps.en: Toss the drained rice with the remaining salt, spread it evenly over the vegetables and press down gently. Carefully pour in the hot stock to cover the rice by 1 cm. Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 30 minutes until the rice has absorbed all the liquid.

steps.sk: Odstav hrniec a nechaj ho prikrytý 10 minút odpočívať. Potom naň polož veľký tanier, rýchlo a rozhodne ho prevráť a pomaly zdvihni – ryža vytvorí koláč so zeleninou a mäsom navrchu.
steps.en: Take the pot off the heat and leave it covered for 10 minutes. Then put a large plate over it, turn it over quickly and decisively and lift the pot away slowly; the rice stands like a cake with the vegetables and chicken on top.

steps.sk: Mandle opraž na suchej panvici 3 minúty, posyp nimi maqlubu a podávaj s jogurtom a šalátom. Kuracie má vnútri aspoň 74 °C. Zvyšky vydržia v chladničke 3 dni.
steps.en: Toast the almonds in a dry frying pan for 3 minutes, scatter them over the maqluba and serve with the yogurt and a salad. The chicken should be at least 74 °C inside. Leftovers keep in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Sabich – pita s vyprážaným baklažánom, vajcom a tahini
title.en: Sabich: pitta with fried aubergine, egg and tahini

description.sk: Izraelská pouličná klasika: mäkký baklažán, vajce natvrdo, zeleninový šalát a tahini v pite.
description.en: An Israeli street-food classic: silky aubergine, hard-boiled egg, chopped salad and tahini in pitta.

steps.sk: Baklažány nakrájaj na kolieska hrubé 1 cm, posoľ ich ½ lyžičkou soli a nechaj 15 minút odstáť. Vajcia var 9 minút natvrdo, schlaď ich v studenej vode a ošúp.
steps.en: Slice the aubergines 1 cm thick, salt them with ½ teaspoon of salt and leave for 15 minutes. Hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool them in cold water and peel.

steps.sk: Baklažány osuš a opekaj ich na oleji po dávkach 3 až 4 minúty z každej strany, kým nie sú zlatohnedé a mäkké ako maslo. Polož ich na papierovú utierku.
steps.en: Pat the aubergine dry and fry it in the oil in batches for 3 to 4 minutes on each side until golden brown and buttery soft. Drain on kitchen paper.

steps.sk: Tahini rozmiešaj s citrónovou šťavou, prelisovaným cesnakom, štipkou soli a 4 až 5 lyžicami studenej vody na hladkú omáčku hustú ako smotana. Najprv zhustne a zrazí sa, ďalšia voda ju znova zjemní.
steps.en: Stir the tahini with the lemon juice, crushed garlic, a pinch of salt and 4 to 5 tablespoons of cold water into a smooth sauce as thick as cream. It seizes and thickens at first; more water loosens it again.

steps.sk: Paradajky a uhorku nakrájaj na drobné kocky a premiešaj s petržlenovou vňaťou a zvyšnou soľou. Vajcia a kyslé uhorky nakrájaj na plátky.
steps.en: Dice the tomatoes and cucumber small and mix with the parsley and remaining salt. Slice the eggs and pickles.

steps.sk: Pity zohrej na suchej panvici, rozrež ich na vrecko a plň baklažánom, vajcom, šalátom a kyslými uhorkami. Polej tahini a podľa chuti srirachou. Jedz hneď; plnku môžeš pripraviť deň vopred.
steps.en: Warm the pittas in a dry frying pan, open them into pockets and fill with the aubergine, egg, salad and pickles. Drizzle with tahini and sriracha to taste. Eat straight away; the fillings can be made a day ahead.

title.sk: Mercimek köftesi – šošovicové guľky s bulgurom
title.en: Mercimek köftesi: red lentil and bulgur patties

description.sk: Turecké vegánske guľky z červenej šošovice a bulguru s paprikou a bylinkami, podávané v šaláte.
description.en: Turkish vegan patties of red lentils and bulgur with paprika and herbs, served in lettuce leaves.

steps.sk: Šošovicu prepláchni, zalej ju 600 ml vody a var 15 minút, kým sa nerozpadne na kašu a vodu takmer celú nevsiakne. Odstav ju, vmiešaj bulgur a soľ, prikry a nechaj 20 minút napučať.
steps.en: Rinse the lentils, cover with 600 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes until they collapse into a purée and have absorbed almost all the water. Take off the heat, stir in the bulgur and salt, cover and leave for 20 minutes to swell.

steps.sk: Medzitým nakrájaj cibuľu nadrobno a na oleji ju speň 6 minút do mäkka. Pridaj paradajkový pretlak, papriku, čili a rímsky kmín a miešaj 1 minútu.
steps.en: Meanwhile, finely chop the onion and soften it in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the tomato paste, paprika, chilli and cumin and stir for 1 minute.

steps.sk: Cibuľovú zmes vmiešaj do šošovice s bulgurom a hnet rukami 3 minúty, kým zmes nie je hladká a súdržná. Ak je suchá, pridaj lyžicu vody.
steps.en: Add the onion mixture to the lentils and bulgur and knead with your hands for 3 minutes until smooth and holding together. Add a spoonful of water if it is dry.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj nasekanú jarnú cibuľku, petržlenovú vňať a citrónovú šťavu a ochutnaj – zmes má byť výrazne korenistá. Mokrými rukami vytvaruj podlhovasté guľky a stlač ich v dlani, aby mali odtlačky prstov.
steps.en: Mix in the chopped spring onions, parsley and lemon juice and taste; it should be boldly spiced. With wet hands, shape small oblong patties, squeezing each in your fist so it bears your finger marks.

steps.sk: Podávaj ich izbovej teploty zabalené v šalátových listoch s mesiačikom citróna. Netreba ich piecť ani vyprážať; v chladničke vydržia 4 dni, takže sú výborné do krabičky.
steps.en: Serve them at room temperature wrapped in lettuce leaves with a lemon wedge. They need neither baking nor frying; they keep in the fridge for 4 days, which makes them great for packed lunches.

title.sk: Kurací tajine s citrónom a olivami
title.en: Chicken tagine with lemon and olives

description.sk: Marocké kuracie stehná dusené so zázvorom, kurkumou, citrónom a zelenými olivami, s kuskusom.
description.en: Moroccan chicken thighs braised with ginger, turmeric, lemon and green olives, with couscous.

steps.sk: Stehná nakrájaj na veľké kusy a zmiešaj s polovicou oleja, prelisovaným cesnakom, nastrúhaným zázvorom, kurkumou, rímskym kmínom, paprikou, škoricou a soľou. Nechaj 15 minút postáť. Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska.
steps.en: Cut the thighs into large pieces and mix them with half the oil, the crushed garlic, grated ginger, turmeric, cumin, paprika, cinnamon and salt. Leave for 15 minutes. Slice the onions into thin half-moons.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci rozohrej zvyšný olej a mäso opekaj 6 minút zo všetkých strán do zlatista. Pridaj cibuľu a opekaj ďalších 5 minút, kým nezmäkne.
steps.en: Heat the remaining oil in a wide pot and brown the chicken on all sides for 6 minutes. Add the onions and cook for another 5 minutes until soft.

steps.sk: Citrón umy horúcou vodou, polovicu nakrájaj na tenké plátky a z druhej vytlač šťavu. Do hrnca pridaj plátky citróna, olivy, 300 ml vody s rozdrobeným bujónom a polovicu bylinek, prikry a var na miernom ohni 30 minút.
steps.en: Scrub the lemon in hot water, slice half of it thinly and juice the other half. Add the lemon slices, olives, 300 ml water with the crumbled stock cube and half the herbs, cover and simmer gently for 30 minutes.

steps.sk: Odkry a var ešte 5 minút, aby omáčka zhustla, a dochuť ju citrónovou šťavou. Mäso je hotové pri 74 °C, keď sa dá ľahko rozdeliť lyžicou.
steps.en: Uncover and simmer for 5 more minutes to thicken the sauce, then sharpen it with the lemon juice. The chicken is done at 74 °C, when it breaks apart easily with a spoon.

steps.sk: Kuskus zalej rovnakým objemom vriacej vody so štipkou soli, prikry a po 5 minútach ho prečechraj vidličkou. Podávaj tajine na kuskuse posypaný zvyšnými bylinkami. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Pour an equal volume of boiling water with a pinch of salt over the couscous, cover and fluff it with a fork after 5 minutes. Serve the tagine on the couscous, scattered with the remaining herbs. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Kefta tajine – mäsové guľky v paradajkách s vajcami
title.en: Kefta tagine: meatballs in tomato sauce with eggs

description.sk: Malé korenisté guľky z hovädzieho dusené v paradajkovej omáčke, navrchu zapečené vajcia.
description.en: Little spiced beef meatballs simmered in tomato sauce with eggs cooked on top.

steps.sk: Mäso zmiešaj s polovicou nasekaných bylinek, lyžičkou rímskeho kmínu, lyžičkou papriky, škoricou, ½ lyžičky soli a korením. Mokrými rukami z neho vytvaruj 20 guliek veľkých ako čerešňa, asi 2,5 cm.
steps.en: Mix the beef with half the chopped herbs, a teaspoon each of cumin and paprika, the cinnamon, ½ teaspoon of salt and the pepper. With wet hands, roll it into 20 cherry-sized balls of about 2.5 cm.

steps.sk: V širokej panvici s pokrievkou rozohrej olej a speň na ňom nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu 5 minút. Pridaj cesnak, zvyšný kmín, papriku a čili a po 30 sekundách paradajky a zvyšnú soľ; var 10 minút.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide lidded frying pan and soften the finely chopped onion for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, remaining cumin, paprika and chilli, then after 30 seconds the tomatoes and remaining salt, and simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Do omáčky vlož guľky v jednej vrstve, prikry a var na miernom ohni 15 minút, v polovici ich otoč. Guľky sú hotové pri 71 °C, keď už nie sú vnútri ružové.
steps.en: Lay the meatballs in the sauce in one layer, cover and simmer gently for 15 minutes, turning them halfway. They are done at 71 °C, when no longer pink inside.

steps.sk: Medzi guľkami urob 4 jamky a do každej rozbi vajce. Prikry a var 6 až 8 minút, kým bielky stuhnú a žĺtky zostanú mäkké.
steps.en: Make 4 hollows between the meatballs and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until the whites set and the yolks stay soft.

steps.sk: Posyp zvyšnými bylinkami a podávaj priamo z panvice s chlebom, ktorým sa v Maroku je namiesto príboru. Omáčku s guľkami môžeš uvariť deň vopred a vajcia pridať až pri ohrievaní.
steps.en: Scatter with the remaining herbs and serve from the pan with bread, which in Morocco is used instead of cutlery. You can make the meatballs in sauce a day ahead and add the eggs when reheating.

title.en: Couscous with seven vegetables and chickpeas

description.sk: Marocký zeleninový ragú s tekvicou, mrkvou, kapustou a cícerom vo voňavom vývare, na kuskuse.
description.en: A Moroccan stew of squash, carrots, cabbage and chickpeas in a fragrant broth, over couscous.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj na mesiačiky, paradajky na kocky, mrkvu a kaleráb na hrubé hranolky, tekvicu a cuketu na veľké kusy s hranou 3 cm a kapustu na široké pásy. Väčšie kusy sa nerozvaria.
steps.en: Cut the onion into wedges, the tomatoes into dice, the carrots and kohlrabi into thick batons, the squash and courgette into large 3 cm chunks and the cabbage into wide strips. Bigger pieces will not fall apart.

steps.sk: Vo veľkom hrnci rozohrej 2 lyžice oleja a speň cibuľu 5 minút. Pridaj všetky koreniny a paradajky a miešaj 2 minúty, potom pridaj mrkvu, kaleráb, kapustu, 1,2 litra vody a rozdrobený bujón a var 20 minút.
steps.en: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot and soften the onion for 5 minutes. Add all the spices and the tomatoes and stir for 2 minutes, then add the carrots, kohlrabi, cabbage, 1.2 litres of water and the crumbled stock cube and simmer for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj tekvicu, cuketu, scedený cícer a hrozienka a var ďalších 15 minút, kým nie je všetka zelenina mäkká, ale drží tvar. Dochuť soľou.
steps.en: Add the squash, courgette, drained chickpeas and raisins and simmer for another 15 minutes until all the vegetables are tender but holding their shape. Season with the salt.

steps.sk: Kuskus premiešaj so zvyšným olejom a zalej ho 300 ml horúceho vývaru z hrnca. Prikry ho a nechaj 5 minút napučať, potom ho vidličkou prečechraj, aby bol sypký.
steps.en: Toss the couscous with the remaining oil and pour over 300 ml of the hot broth from the pot. Cover and leave for 5 minutes to swell, then fluff it up with a fork.

steps.sk: Kuskus navŕš na tanier, do stredu urob jamku a naplň ju zeleninou s cícerom. Polej vývarom a posyp koriandrovou vňaťou. Zelenina s vývarom vydrží v chladničke 4 dni, kuskus pripravuj čerstvý.
steps.en: Pile the couscous on a platter, make a well in the middle and fill it with the vegetables and chickpeas. Spoon over some broth and scatter with coriander. The vegetables in broth keep for 4 days; make the couscous fresh.

title.sk: Lablabi – tuniská cícerová polievka s chlebom a vajcom
title.en: Lablabi: Tunisian chickpea soup with bread and egg

description.sk: Lacná korenistá polievka z cícera s cesnakom a rímskym kmínom, naliata na chlieb, s vajcom navrchu.
description.en: A cheap, spiced chickpea soup with garlic and cumin, poured over bread and topped with an egg.

steps.sk: Cesnak roztlač s ¼ lyžičky soli na pastu, cícer sceď a prepláchni. V hrnci rozohrej 2 lyžice oleja, pridaj cesnak, rímsky kmín, papriku, čili a pretlak a miešaj 1 minútu, kým nezavonia.
steps.en: Crush the garlic with ¼ teaspoon of salt to a paste; drain and rinse the chickpeas. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pot, add the garlic, cumin, paprika, chilli and tomato paste and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.

steps.sk: Pridaj cícer, 1 liter vody a rozdrobený bujón a var 15 minút, kým cícer nezmäkne a vývar výrazne nevonia kmínom. Dochuť citrónovou šťavou.
steps.en: Add the chickpeas, 1 litre of water and the crumbled stock cube and simmer for 15 minutes until the chickpeas are soft and the broth tastes strongly of cumin. Season with the lemon juice.

steps.sk: Vajcia var 6 minút, aby mali tekutý žĺtok, ponor ich do studenej vody a ošúp. Chlieb natrhaj na kúsky a rozdeľ ho do hlbokých misiek.
steps.en: Boil the eggs for 6 minutes so the yolks stay runny, plunge them into cold water and peel. Tear the bread into pieces and divide it between deep bowls.

steps.sk: Chlieb zalej horúcou polievkou s cícerom, nechaj ho minútu nasiaknuť a navrch polož rozpolené vajce. Pokvapkaj zvyšným olejom a posyp petržlenovou vňaťou a ďalšou štipkou kmínu.
steps.en: Ladle the hot chickpea soup over the bread, let it soak for a minute and top with a halved egg. Drizzle with the remaining oil and sprinkle with parsley and another pinch of cumin.

steps.sk: Pri jedle vajce rozmiešaj do polievky, žĺtok ju zjemní. Polievka bez chleba a vajec vydrží v chladničke 4 dni; v Tunise sa je na raňajky aj na obed.
steps.en: Stir the egg into the soup as you eat; the yolk makes it silky. Without the bread and eggs the soup keeps in the fridge for 4 days; in Tunisia it is eaten for breakfast as well as lunch.

title.sk: Koshari – egyptská šošovica s ryžou a cestovinami
title.en: Koshari: Egyptian lentils, rice and pasta with spiced tomato sauce

description.sk: Najobľúbenejšie egyptské pouličné jedlo: ryža, šošovica a cestoviny s kyslou paradajkovou omáčkou a chrumkavou cibuľou.
description.en: Egypt's favourite street food: rice, lentils and pasta with a tangy tomato sauce and crispy onions.

steps.sk: Šošovicu prepláchni, zalej ju 1 litrom vody a var 20 až 25 minút, kým nie je mäkká, ale drží tvar. Na konci ju osoľ ½ lyžičkou soli a sceď.
steps.en: Rinse the lentils, cover with 1 litre of water and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes until tender but holding their shape. Salt them with ½ teaspoon of salt at the end and drain.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj na veľmi tenké polkolieska. Na panvici rozohrej olej a cibuľu na ňom smaž na strednom ohni 15 až 20 minút za častého miešania, kým nie je tmavohnedá a chrumkavá. Vyber ju na papierovú utierku a olej si odlož.
steps.en: Slice the onions very thinly. Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the onions over a medium heat, stirring often, for 15 to 20 minutes until dark brown and crisp. Drain them on kitchen paper and keep the oil.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni, opeč ju minútu na 2 lyžiciach cibuľového oleja, zalej 400 ml vody s ¼ lyžičky soli a var prikrytú 15 minút. Cestoviny uvar vo vode s ½ lyžičkou soli podľa obalu a sceď ich.
steps.en: Rinse the rice, toast it for a minute in 2 tablespoons of the onion oil, add 400 ml water with ¼ teaspoon of salt and cook, covered, for 15 minutes. Cook the pasta in water with ½ teaspoon of salt as the packet directs and drain.

steps.sk: Na omáčku opeč na lyžici cibuľového oleja prelisovaný cesnak, rímsky kmín, koriander, čili a škoricu 30 sekúnd, potom pridaj pretlak, paradajky, cukor a zvyšnú soľ a var 15 minút. Nakoniec vmiešaj ocot – kyslosť je pre koshari typická.
steps.en: For the sauce, fry the crushed garlic, cumin, coriander, chilli and cinnamon in a tablespoon of the onion oil for 30 seconds, then add the tomato paste, tomatoes, sugar and remaining salt and simmer for 15 minutes. Finally stir in the vinegar; the tang is typical of koshari.

steps.sk: Cícer prehrej v trošku vody a sceď. Do misiek vrstvi ryžu, šošovicu a cestoviny, polej ich paradajkovou omáčkou a navrch daj cícer a chrumkavú cibuľu. Zložky vydržia oddelene v chladničke 4 dni; cibuľu pridávaj až pri podávaní.
steps.en: Warm the chickpeas in a little water and drain. Layer the rice, lentils and pasta in bowls, spoon over the tomato sauce and top with the chickpeas and crispy onions. Stored separately, the parts keep in the fridge for 4 days; add the onions only when serving.

title.sk: Pečená treska v chermoule so zemiakmi

description.sk: Biela ryba v marináde z koriandra, petržlenovej vňate, citróna a korenia, pečená na zemiakoch.
description.en: White fish in a marinade of coriander, parsley, lemon and spices, baked on sliced potatoes.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Na chermoulu nasekaj koriandrovú a petržlenovú vňať čo najjemnejšie a zmiešaj ich s prelisovaným cesnakom, citrónovou šťavou, rímskym kmínom, paprikou, čili, 3 lyžicami oleja a ½ lyžičky soli.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. For the chermoula, chop the coriander and parsley as finely as you can and mix them with the crushed garlic, lemon juice, cumin, paprika, chilli, 3 tablespoons of oil and ½ teaspoon of salt.

steps.sk: Rybu osuš, potri ju tretinou chermouly a nechaj 15 minút v chladničke marinovať. Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kolieska hrubé 5 mm, papriku na prúžky a paradajky na plátky.
steps.en: Pat the fish dry, rub it with a third of the chermoula and leave it to marinate in the fridge for 15 minutes. Peel the potatoes and slice them 5 mm thick; cut the pepper into strips and the tomatoes into slices.

steps.sk: Zemiaky a papriku premiešaj so zvyšnou chermoulou, zvyšným olejom a zvyšnou soľou, rozlož ich v pekáči a peč 20 minút, kým nezačnú mäknúť.
steps.en: Toss the potatoes and pepper with the rest of the chermoula, the remaining oil and salt, spread them in a roasting dish and bake for 20 minutes until they start to soften.

steps.sk: Na zemiaky polož plátky paradajok, olivy a rybu, podlej 3 lyžicami vody a peč ďalších 12 až 15 minút. Ryba je hotová, keď je biela, nepriesvitná a ľahko sa oddeľuje na lupienky.
steps.en: Lay the tomato slices, olives and fish on the potatoes, add 3 tablespoons of water and bake for another 12 to 15 minutes. The fish is done when white, opaque and flaking easily.

steps.sk: Podávaj priamo z pekáča s chlebom alebo šalátom. Chermoula sa hodí aj ku kuraciemu mäsu či zelenine; upečenú rybu zjedz v ten istý deň.
steps.en: Serve straight from the dish with bread or a salad. Chermoula also suits chicken and vegetables; eat the baked fish the same day.
